title: Printers and print settings
intro: Define printer records in Manage, configure what each print job contains, then assign printers to devices in Settings.

sections.title: Printers
sections.intro: Printer records store connection details used across receipt, kitchen, and report printing.
steps: Add printers with name, type, and connection settings.
Link printers to kitchens and device Settings so tickets reach the right hardware.
sections.caption: Printers master list in Manage.

sections.title: Print settings
sections.intro: Print settings control templates and options for temp bills, final receipts, kitchen tickets, summaries, and delivery slips.
steps: Edit each print type (Temp, Final, Kitchen, Summary, Delivery).
Save so new orders use the updated layout and fields.
sections.caption: Print settings tab.

sections.title: Printer form
steps: Add name and connection: network IP/port or USB identifiers.
Save — assign in kitchens and device settings.
sections.caption: Printer form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Friendly name in admin and device pickers.

fields.name: Type
fields.effect: Receipt, kitchen, or label driver profile.

fields.name: VID / PID
fields.effect: USB vendor/product IDs for direct-attached printers.

sections.title: Print setting form
sections.intro: Each print job type (temp bill, final receipt, kitchen, summary, delivery) has its own template.
steps: Open Print settings tab and pick a job type.
Configure logo, header/footer sections, VAT block, and margins.
Toggle line columns shown on receipts.
Save — the next print uses the updated layout.
sections.caption: Print template editor.

fields.name: Show logo
fields.effect: Includes uploaded logo on the ticket.

fields.name: Header / footer sections
fields.effect: Rich text or image blocks above and below the body.

fields.name: VAT name / number
fields.effect: Tax registration block on guest receipts.

fields.name: Item columns
fields.effect: Toggle number, name, qty, price, and line total columns.
